label: Off-world contingent support and late support: controls for the world scope of J1
paraphrase: Closed controls on two interpretations, both with worlds false and true, universal access, and three concrete candidates t0, t1, t2, where t0 and t1 exist at both worlds and t2 only at true; evaluated at false. (1) Off-world contingent support (at false t0 supports t1; at true t2 supports t1): no contingent concrete support holds at the selected world but fails at every world (t2 supports the necessary t1 at true and is absent at false); the recorded rival that some necessary concretum is supported somewhere by a concretum absent from an accessible world holds; a necessary concretum, concrete population, well-founded actual grounding, every actual contingent concretum grounded, reflexive access, the well-founded cross-world union of necessary support, coverage and excluded middle hold; and t0 is a necessary actual concretum with no existing concrete supporter at any world. (2) Late support (at false t0 supports t1; at true t2 supports t0): no contingent concrete support at the selected world, a necessary concretum, concrete population, well-founded actual grounding, every actual contingent concretum grounded, reflexive access, the well-founded union, excluded middle and the one-way no-novel-edge condition hold, while no contingent concrete support at every world, coverage and the join's endpoint fail. Statements about these interpretations only.
